title: Red Teaming GPT-4V: Are GPT-4V Safe Against Uni/Multi-Modal Jailbreak Attacks?
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark was not designed to measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on 11 general safety policies such as violence, hate, and criminal planning.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was outside the scope of its investigation into general safety vulnerabilities.
